y0: The Woman Who Poured Precious Perfume
y1: In Bethany, a woman brought very expensive perfume and poured it on Jesus' head. The whole room was filled with a beautiful fragrance.
y2: The disciples said, "Why is she wasting it?" but Jesus said, "This woman did a good thing for Me. She prepared Me for burial. What this woman did will be told all over the world."
y3: Jesus Sold for Thirty Pieces of Silver
y4: But one of the disciples, Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests and said, "What will you give me if I hand Jesus over to you?"
y5: They gave him thirty pieces of silver. The woman gave Jesus her most precious thing, but Judas traded Jesus for money.
y6: This is My Body, My Blood
y7: On the evening of the Passover, Jesus ate with His disciples. Jesus broke the bread, gave it to them, and said, "Take, eat; this is My body."
y8: Then He gave them the cup and said, "This is My blood of the covenant. It is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins." Jesus was going to give His body and blood for us.
y10: On the way to the Mount of Olives, Jesus said, "Tonight, all of you will leave Me."
y11: When Peter said, "I will never leave You!" Jesus said, "Tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times." Even so, Jesus loved His disciples to the very end.
verse: "This is My blood of the covenant. It is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins."
prayer: Jesus, thank You for Your love in giving Your body and pouring out Your blood for me. Like the woman who poured the perfume, let me give You my most precious thing. I believe in You, who loves me to the very end even when I am weak like Peter. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: perfume. It is a very sweet-smelling and expensive oil. The woman poured perfume on Jesus.
d1: Judas. He was one of Jesus' twelve disciples, but he sold Jesus for money. Judas received thirty pieces of silver.
d2: Passover. It is a holiday remembering how God saved Israel from Egypt. On the evening of the Passover, Jesus ate with His disciples.
d3: covenant. It is a firm promise God makes with us. This is My blood of the covenant.
d4: rooster. It is a bird that crows 'cock-a-doodle-doo' early in the morning. Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.
